title: Pass
text: Pass. These are a great size, durable and good looking.  They are shipped rolled up, however, and there’s a curved edge on each one as a result.  Nothing will make it flat!  I’ve tried hot water, weighting them flat down and time.  Nothing works.  I’ll probably keep them but I wouldn’t buy them again.
